insight: Built in early 2023 by a solo dev ('comfyanonymous') with no prior ML experience; Comfy Org later raised ~$48M.
name: ComfyUI
tagline: Node-based visual AI — wire up image, video, and audio diffusion pipelines.
description: An open-source, node-graph interface for diffusion models — build precise, reproducible image/video/audio pipelines on an infinite canvas where every model and parameter is visible. Runs locally on your own GPU or as a desktop app, with thousands of community nodes.

modelSupport.notes: Runs open diffusion models you supply (FLUX, Stable Diffusion, video models); no LLM required.

edge: Exposes the whole diffusion pipeline as a node graph, so any workflow is reproducible and shareable as one JSON file.
